packet.userIntent: Knowledge entry writes keep failing validation.
packet.finalAssistantSummary: Reserved HTML comment markers were the cause.

evidence.excerpt: KnowledgeValidationError: body must not contain reserved text: <!-- cheatcodes-entry
Entry text must never contain the reserved HTML comment markers; they delimit entry records on disk.

claims.text: Generated entry text must never contain the reserved HTML comment markers used as record delimiters.

proposedEntry.title: Never emit reserved entry markers
proposedEntry.summary: Entry title, summary, body, and tags must not contain the cheatcodes entry comment markers.
proposedEntry.body: The knowledge file delimits entries with HTML comment markers. Any generated text containing those markers corrupts parsing, so validators reject them outright.
